method.baseline: The cited +$213.32 case: reference-anchored first 0%, second 10% final-confirmation body, fixed 30%/70% setup risk split, 30-minute entry deadline, common 1.25R reference target, new-target pending cancellation. Original SL unchanged until an experimental BE event.
method.trigger: Both definitions are simulated: progress from original reference to common TP, or from second-entry price to TP. At 80% of a 1.25R reference target the reference trigger is exactly original 1R. Same fixed $4 total setup risk.
method.management: At trigger, close entire filled second leg, move active first leg SL to its own entry, retain first TP unless explicitly extending runner. Cancel any pending entries when management activates. second-filled mode activates only if second is active; any-filled mode can protect a lone first fill and cancels unfilled second. If neither leg filled, no management event.
method.variants: 1.25R/1.5R/2R targets; 60/70/75/80/85/90/95% progress; reference and second-entry origins; second-filled and any-filled eligibility. Separate close-only and BE-only attribution. Also 80% trigger with 1.5R/2R runner after a 1.25R setup.
method.accounting: Positive-net setup win rate, not runner TP rate. First-leg BE and second-leg early profit reported separately. A BE runner plus second-leg profit is a winning setup. Outcomes must agree across all OHLC paths; entire uncertain/open setups excluded from main P&L. Matched-cohort P&L compares only setups whose outcomes are certain in both candidate and baseline.
method.execution: Exhaustive M15 OHLC event-order state machine, dynamic BE stop applies only after trigger, BUY/SELL symmetry. Same-candle trigger/BE/TP conflicts stay uncertain. Missing history stays uncertain; known protected runners have zero ideal gross-loss lower bound after BE. Stops, targets, early closes and BE fills are ideal exact levels, with no gap slippage or costs.
method.cash: Fixed $4 total setup risk, no compounding, ideal fractional lots. No spread, commission, financing, slippage, minimum-lot sizing, margin, maximum-open-trade limits, daily loss cap or overlap half-risk adjustments. BE means entry price before costs; it is not a guarantee of zero actual loss. Current $200 Exness min-lot constraint remains.
method.validation: Simulator matches the prior 1.25R baseline $213.32 and all its major counts. Fixtures cover pre-trigger stop immutability, original-SL losses without trigger, trigger then BE, trigger then runner TP, BUY/SELL symmetry, and ambiguous low-before/high-before ordering. All price distances are measured without later candles.
method.selection: Earlier outcomes truncated at October 1 and November 1. Require >=85% both fills, >=50% profitable resolved setups, >=70% baseline resolved count, positive conservative R; maximize conservative R, then known-outcome R. Choices frozen before later-month scoring.
method.limits: Reused historical sample, multiple searches and a SELL-heavy instrument period. Chronological comparisons are not independent unseen validation. More ambiguous management exits can distort headline results through exclusion; matched-cohort results and conservative bounds are essential. Higher-target variants must also be compared against HOLD at their same target, not just the cited 1.25R baseline. No live strategy, exits, account settings or orders changed.

commonCohort.definition: Identical archived setup indices whose outcomes are known for hold, reference-origin 80%, and reference-origin 90%; second-filled activation, unchanged 1.25R runner target.

commonCohortResampling.method: Paired confirmation-calendar-day resampling on the common certain cohort, 10,000 replicates, Python random seed 20261120. Conditional on this restricted cohort; does not resolve omitted OHLC cases or correct for parameter selection. Not independent significance evidence.
